description: This file defines custom permission classes and utility functions for role-based access control in a Django REST Framework API, specifically for inventory management roles such as inventory admins, admins, and managers.

classes.name: IsInventoryAdminOrReadOnly
classes.description: Allows read-only access to authenticated users, with write access limited to inventory administrators (staff, superusers, or users in the 'inventory_admins' group).

classes.name: IsInventoryAdmin
classes.description: Strict permission class allowing only inventory administrators to access certain endpoints.

classes.name: IsAdminOrManagerRole
classes.description: Permission that grants access only to users with roles 'admin' or 'manager', or staff/superuser.

methods.name: bool user_has_any_role(user, roles: Iterable[str])
methods.description: Checks if a user has any of the specified roles, considering superuser/staff status and user profile roles.

methods.name: bool has_permission(self, request: Request, view: View)
